label: Plan markup (alpha)
description: In-house plan markup over takeoff plan PDFs: draw / highlight / stamp plus calibrated measure (distance / area), rendered through the shared pdf.js viewer with a Konva overlay and persisted per plan file. Alpha; #1511 Phase 1.

label: AI visual-takeoff assist (alpha)
description: Two ways to get DRAFT device counts off a plan sheet, both reviewed row by row and neither ever auto-committed. (1) Crop a region in the markup viewer and get counts back. (2) The two-step fixture takeoff: build a fixture list by reading the plan set's own schedule (searched across every sheet, since the schedule is usually its own sheet), approve that list, then find exactly those types on any page. Accepted counts land as visible marks on the plan. Runs through the Codex CLI on the host using the platform owner's ChatGPT auth, never an API key, with gpt-5.6-luna at max reasoning by default; it is additionally hard-gated on isSiteAdmin and is Mike-only until a multi-tenant auth story exists. Alpha; #1545.

label: Single-line diagram builder
description: Permit-ready electrical one-line diagram builder for the service chain (utility -> meter/main -> panels -> loads) with E/N tags and a license-block PDF export. The manual editor; distinct from the automated site_plan_automation flag. Field ask (Zak, 7/16).

label: AIVA Voice Bridge
